messages.subject: Time series
parts:
Hi, i'm trying to graph a time series with ggplot2, but i need to highlight an area on the  grap (between two periods).
I need something like this (R code example):

#serie:
x<-diffinv(rnorm(100))
plot.ts(x,type='n')
abline(v=seq(40,80,by=0.1),col="gray80")
lines(x)
box()

#ugly graph :(

thanks!!!

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Time series
parts:
Hi:

Here's one approach:

x <- diffinv(rnorm(100))
DF <- data.frame(time = seq_along(x), dint = x)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = time, y = dint)) +
theme_bw() +
geom_rect(xmin = 40, xmax = 80, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.05) +
geom_line(size = 1)

Since you're only creating one rectangle, it's OK to set the
aesthetics xmin to ymax in this case. For some reason, I found it
necessary to set alpha to a low value in geom_rect() in order to get
some background transparency.

Dennis
